assessment.reasoning: Nutbox Labs' conversion drift and AOV decline are driven by operational bottlenecks (packaging damage on heavy SKUs and stockouts) rather than price resistance. The nearest competitor successfully raised prices by 8% without losing share, signaling strong category pricing power. Furthermore, 27% of customers are price-insensitive bulk regulars and 22% are delivery-focused gift buyers, meaning any promotional intervention would heavily subsidize orders that would occur at full price. Given that all interventions require an 18%–20% break-even incremental share and a single experiment costs ~2.8x the annual profit pool, spending scarce experimentation budget on discounts is expected to destroy contribution.
